gen-audiowide-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text reads as a plain sans with tall bodies that make the lowercase look bold, and its terminals flare outward a touch. Audiowide's tube-like line sits above it.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-synonym: Tight, confident, upright. Oswald packs its rows close and sturdy, while Synonym lays down a plain sans stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-bengal: Ornate and bookish, with a pronounced x-height. Almendra Display handles the flourish, never pinching its letters shut; Noto Sans Bengali takes the plain sans job, its capitals barely taller than lowercase and its mouths distinctly open.
gen-audiowide-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a large central band in the line and curved letters whose mouths stay wide and unclosed. Nata Sans holds a technical-pen steadiness down a whole page, a quiet counterpart to Audiowide's tiled glyphs.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-bhaiks: Ornate, literary, never pinched. Almendra Display brings its pronounced x-height up front, and Noto Sans Bhaiksuki follows with swollen, rope-coiled lowercase and apertures that stay easily readable.
gen-audiowide-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its caps barely above the x-height, with open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined. Audiowide hums above it with featureless, tiled letters, and Nobile carries the paragraphs below with a steadier, lower pulse.
gen-fs-oswald-plus-jakarta-sans: Confident from the first line, Oswald sets its rows tightly knit and strong. Plus Jakarta Sans adds a monoline, rope-like consistency in every stem and bowl, with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads contemporary, with its mean line set high. Almendra Display earns its keep big and short, where its ornate, never-pinched letters get room to show off.
gen-audiowide-gf-nokora: Audiowide's single track width, like a neon tube, is the first thing you notice. It excels at display, while Nokora lays a wide-open s and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-cham: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut. Noto Sans Cham follows as a plain sans, its rounded lowercase tall and its c shapes offering plenty of entry space.
